headline: Government to Restrict Pertalite Distribution; Purbaya Focuses on Fixing DTSEN | Republika Online
summary: The government is preparing a Pertalite restriction system for households in deciles 9 and 10. Finance minister Purbaya is focused on fixing the DTSEN welfare data system.
why: Pertalite is a subsidised gasoline grade in Indonesia, so changes to its distribution affect fuel subsidy spending and retail fuel demand.
